local_complete.reason: C9 permits complete only after every active local obligation passes with no unresolved blocker, repair, CI wait, or conflicting evidence.
local_complete.evidence: supertraverse C9 requires a validated completed-local receipt with manifests, command results, reviews, acceptance coverage, obligations, and timestamp; the fixture supplies all of them.

label_without_evidence.reason: A completed-local label is never sufficient proof.
label_without_evidence.evidence: supertraverse C9 says a label or report without the receipt and required files is BLOCKED; the fixture is missing that evidence.

failed_descendant.reason: An ancestor can roll up to completed-local only when every active descendant has valid completion evidence or an authorized disposition.
failed_descendant.evidence: supertraverse C7 retains partial progress when an active descendant failed without disposition, as stated by this fixture.

failed_review.reason: Local publication retains task and final review gates.
failed_review.evidence: superloop L6 and superrun Step 3a require passing review outcomes in the completed-local receipt; this fixture has a failed required review.

late_predecessor.reason: Repair history is historical and cannot replace the current active successor.
late_predecessor.evidence: supertraverse C8 follows the recorded successor chain and C9 states delayed predecessor closeouts cannot complete or overwrite a successor.

repair_replay.reason: Fresh ticks reconcile the stable Decision ID and published Successor link idempotently.
repair_replay.evidence: supertraverse C8 replay and superagent repair reconciliation require reusing an existing successor without resetting the row or creating another successor.

legacy_to_local.reason: An unmarked legacy root means github, so effective none is a contract mismatch handled before side effects.
legacy_to_local.evidence: superloop L2 and supertraverse C9 require WAITING FOR INPUT/BLOCKED before git, gh, credentials, dispatch, or merge claims.

local_to_github.reason: The recorded local mode is immutable for the goal and differs from effective github.
local_to_github.evidence: superloop L2 parks a mismatch without integration operations, and supertraverse C9 rejects a mismatched root as integration proof.

local_receipt_in_github.reason: A local receipt is completion evidence only in effective none mode.
local_receipt_in_github.evidence: supertraverse C2/C4/C9 explicitly says completed-local is not merged or integrated in github mode.

local_sdd.reason: The local superrun override binds the SDD controller and every child prompt.
local_sdd.evidence: superrun Steps 2, 3, 3a, and 5 prohibit worktree/commit/PR/merge/finishing while retaining local tests, task review, final review, and acceptance verification.
